description: Taboola bulk server-to-server conversions posted to trc.taboola.com/{account-id}/log/3/bulk-s2s-action. Single postbacks are vendor/taboola-s2s. The base pixel loader is vendor/taboola.

params.name: account_id
params.description: It is the numeric Taboola Account ID in the path as `/{account-id}/log/3/bulk-s2s-action`.
params.fix_hint: Put the Realize Account ID in the path, such as `/123456/log/3/bulk-s2s-action`.

params.description: Taboola bulk accepts a JSON object.

params.name: actions
params.description: Taboola requires an array with at most 1000 conversion objects.

params.name: actions[]
params.description: Every Taboola bulk action is an object.

params.name: click-id
params.description: It is the Taboola Click ID from the landing page. Taboola documents `click-id` as required on every bulk record.
params.fix_hint: Send `click-id` with the Click ID Taboola appended to the landing page.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: It is milliseconds since Unix epoch. Taboola documents `timestamp` as required on bulk records.
params.fix_hint: Send milliseconds since epoch, such as `1620723457405`.

params.name: name
params.description: It is the event name as defined in Realize Conversion settings, not the Conversion Name.
params.fix_hint: Set `name` to the Event Name from Realize, such as `LEAD`.

params.name: revenue
params.description: It is the conversion value. Taboola documents a float such as `10` or `9.99`.

params.name: currency
params.description: It is the revenue currency. Taboola documents a fixed list of three-letter codes, case-sensitive. Omit it to use the account default.
params.fix_hint: Use a documented code such as `USD`.

params.name: quantity
params.description: It is the item quantity for the order. Taboola documents an integer.
params.fix_hint: Send an integer quantity, such as `3`.

params.name: orderid
params.description: It is an order ID from the advertiser CRM. Taboola documents it as optional.
